title: Zeta Forester vs Bajan Golf Associates Ltd – September 2nd 2020
text:
BARBADOS 

Case: 2014/039 

Zeta Foster 

-AND- 

IN THE EMPLOYMENT RIGHTS TRIBUNAL 

 CLAIMANT 

Bajan Golf Associates Limited 

 RESPONDENT 

DATE: 

 August 25th 2020 and September 2nd 2020 

BEFORE: 

 Christopher Blackman Esq, GCM; Q.C. Chairman 
 Member 
 Edward Bushell, Esq. 
 Member 
 Beverley Beckles 

APPEARANCES: Mrs. Sheena-Maria Brathwaite Drakes, Attorney-at-Law for the 

 Mark Hasler, Respondent in person. 

Claimant 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

ORDER 

The Tribunal on hearing Mrs. Sheena-Maria Brathwaite Drakes, Counsel for the 
Claimant and Mr. Mark Hasler on behalf of the Respondent, and Upon Reading the 
Witness Statement of the Claimant, and on a consideration of the decision dated 
February 10, 2020 in the matter of Therese Foster v. Sinclair Gittens, determined 
that the Claimant had been unfairly dismissed. 

The Tribunal grants an award of $3195.00 pursuant to section 22 (1) (e) of the 
Employment Rights Act (the Act) being 10 weeks’ pay in lieu of notice, and an award 
of $16, 294.50 being the basic award pursuant to paragraph 2 (2) (c) of the Fifth 
Schedule, an aggregate amount of $19, 489.50 to be paid by the Respondent to the 
Claimant. The Tribunal deducts the sum of $5,000.00 previously paid and BY 
CONSENT orders that the balance or sum of $14,489.50 be paid as follows: The sum 
of $5,000.00 within 30 days of 2, September, 2020; the sum of $5,000.00 on or 
before 31 December, 2020 and the balance of $4,489.50 on or before 31 March, 
2021. 

Payments made by the Respondent shall be made to the Client Account of Mrs. 
Sheena-Maria Brathwaite Drakes and the receipt of Mrs. Sheena-Maria Brathwaite 
Drakes shall constitute a good release and discharge of the obligations of the 
Respondent to the Claimant. The parties are at liberty to vary any of the foregoing 
terms as to payment. 

On behalf of the Tribunal. 

Dated this 2nd day of September, 2020. 

Christopher Blackman 

Chairman
